$comment: Presentation model for the Picks desk. Product identity and every store-side value live in data/product-intent.json and stay blank until confirmed; this file only decides how those rows are shown and what the desk says about them.
desk_statement: Five links were submitted for marketing. None of them identifies a product we can confirm, so this page shows the work rather than the verdict: what we were given, what we checked, what is still missing, and where you can check it yourself in a minute.

columns.label: Price
columns.blank_reason: Only Amazon-served content or Creators/PA API output may carry a price (SRC-02 §2(b)); neither is available here

columns.label: Rating
columns.blank_reason: Customer reviews and star ratings require a link obtained via Creators API or PA API (SRC-02 §6(t))

columns.label: Observed redirect (kept separate)
columns.blank_reason: Not observable from the build sandbox; egress to that host is blocked

value_policy: A populated cell needs a source id. A blank cell needs a reason. Both are rendered, because a blank with a reason is a usable answer and a blank without one is a rumour.

editorial_context.note: The brief's guide topics concern air fryers and multi-function kitchen appliances. Whether the five links belong to that category is one of the unresolved items, so no guide names a product and no product row claims a category.

what_a_row_gives_the_reader: a straight answer about whether we can cite the product at all
the exact identifier we were given, so the reader can check it independently
a link to the official store help page or listing when one exists
the decision criteria that do not depend on our data: capacity, footprint, cleaning, controls, and what to look for on the listing
